title: HOTFIX: classesPanel test run exits non-zero — unhandled 'update unmounted root' + JSFL fetch rejection
description: HOTFIX: classesPanel test run exited non-zero from ONE unhandled rejection 'Cannot update an unmounted root.' (ClassesPanel.tsx:165 pushDoc inside async syncToDoc, kicked off by the unmount flush / debounced reconcile, resolving AFTER unmount). Fix: added a mountedRef (set false in an unmount cleanup) and gated the post-await pushDoc in syncToDoc and the setPersistWarning callbacks in observeVfsWrite on it. Sync per-keystroke fold already captured edits pre-unmount, so no data loss. The alleged JSFL fetch rejection is NOT unhandled — runtime.ts _importRemoteUrl already try/catches fetch and returns the doc (only a console.warn). Evidence: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui test EXIT=0 (111 files, 1263 tests, no Errors line); full ordered build EXIT=0.
